description: Standalone brand-creative shots — fun, stylised illustrations using founders + product catalogue refs. Add new frames as one-offs.

frames.prompt:
ABSOLUTELY NO READABLE TEXT, WORDS, LETTERS, OR LOGOS anywhere in this image — no headlines, no banners, no captions, no badges, no wordmarks of any kind. The image is purely a wordless cartoon illustration.

Vibrant cartoon-illustrated promotional poster, 16:9 widescreen landscape, dynamic action composition.

[Context] DiggerLid brand-creative shot — the founder rides a DiggerLid Pro Mat like a surfboard down a swelling wave of fresh dirt. The dig metaphor recast as surfing. Fun, energetic, on-brand for an Australian tradie audience.

[Visual] The main character is one of the DiggerLid founders — preserve his face exactly from the reference portrait attached (broad-shouldered build, neatly-trimmed dark moustache, wearing a black baseball cap with the brim facing forward). In the cartoon he wears a loud red-and-green Hawaiian shirt with palm-leaf motifs, board shorts, sunglasses on, grinning wide with mouth open mid-laugh.

He is balanced in a classic SURFER STANCE on top of a DiggerLid Pro Mat — preserve the Pro Mat's shape and proportions from the reference images attached: a long rectangular padded waterproof PVC mat with rounded edges, predominantly dark grey/black with subtle yellow DiggerLid trim/tags visible at the edges. The mat is used as a surfboard, held flat under his feet, knees bent, one arm extended outward for balance, the other arm held back.

He is mid-ride on a MASSIVE WAVE OF FRESH BROWN DIRT — a swelling, curling tower of earth replacing what would normally be water. The dirt wave crests over him like a barrel, with chunks of dirt clods spraying off the crest into the air, fine soil mist trailing behind. The wave is rendered in rich earth-brown tones with darker brown shadow at the base and warm sunlit highlights on the crest.

Behind the scene: bright cartoon-blue sky, scattered cartoon-white fluffy clouds, a big yellow comic-style sunburst radiating outward from behind him. A few small flying clods of dirt in the air around him.

[Format] 16:9 widescreen landscape.

[Style] Vibrant cartoon-illustrated promotional poster style — heavy black outlines, saturated primary colours, comic-strip energy, slight halftone shading. DiggerLid brand palette threaded through: red, vivid yellow (#f5eb19), navy. Dynamic action composition with motion lines emanating from the mat tail. The wave is dirt, not water — keep this unmistakable through earthy brown tones, scattered loose clods, and the absence of any blue water tones below his feet.

REMINDER: zero readable text anywhere — no DiggerLid wordmark, no signage, no captions, no labels of any kind.

CAP LOCK — IMPORTANT character invariant: Luke ALWAYS wears his black baseball cap with the brim facing forward. The cap is firmly on his head in this image, brim pointing forward, dark hair just visible at the temples below the cap line. Do NOT render him bareheaded. Do NOT replace the cap with any other headwear. Do NOT show his full hair. The cap stays on, fitted snugly, even mid-surf. This is a non-negotiable element of his character identity for this brand.

ABSOLUTELY NO READABLE TEXT, WORDS, LETTERS, OR LOGOS anywhere in this image. No headlines, no banners, no captions, no badges, no wordmarks. Pure cinematic photograph, no overlays.

[Context] DiggerLid brand-creative shot — Outback Mad Max. Luke, the DiggerLid founder, as a lone post-apocalyptic Australian-outback wanderer. His PRO Enclosure-covered mini-excavator is his ride, his Hauler Bag is his kit, his KAJO Grease Gun is his sidearm. Epic, edgy, brand-elevated.

[Visual] Wide cinematic anamorphic 16:9 landscape, golden-hour outback Australia. The frame is dust-bleached and warm — saturated terracotta-red dirt underfoot, parched ochre and rust-gold tones in the dust haze, distant heat shimmer, scrubby low spinifex grass scattered toward the horizon.

CENTRAL CHARACTER (right of centre, mid-stride): the DiggerLid founder Luke — preserve his face exactly from the reference portrait attached (broad-shouldered build, neatly-trimmed dark moustache, black baseball cap with brim forward, dark hair just visible at the temples). He is dressed in worn post-apocalyptic outback rig: heavy canvas duster jacket over a faded dust-streaked dark tee, weathered jeans, dusty leather work boots. Reflective aviator sunglasses. A streak of red dust across one cheek. Determined, lone-wanderer expression — half a slight smirk. Mid-stride, walking directly toward the camera.

OVER HIS LEFT SHOULDER: a DiggerLid Hauler Bag — preserve the bag's silhouette and proportions exactly from the reference image attached. It is a heavy-duty large duffel/luggage-style bag, predominantly dark grey/black ballistic fabric construction with reinforced base, sturdy carry handles, shoulder strap slung across his torso. The bag is loaded — the wooden handle of a hammer and the head of an adjustable wrench poke out of the partly-open top zipper.

AT HIS RIGHT HIP, holstered like a Western sidearm in a custom leather rig: a DiggerLid KAJO Grease Gun — preserve the grease gun's shape from the reference image attached (a two-handed pistol-grip grease gun with a long cylindrical barrel and a flexible nozzle hose). Holstered barrel-down, hose coiled at his hip.

DEEP BACKGROUND (roughly 30 metres behind him, mid-ground left): the DiggerLid PRO Enclosure-covered XCMG XE17U mini-excavator parked on the red dirt — preserve the cover's grey ripstop fabric, DiggerLid wordmark on the side panel, and yellow tether tabs from the product reference attached. The machine is half-obscured by drifting red dust, looks like his post-apocalyptic ride.

FAR HORIZON: a building red dust storm wall sweeping in from the right edge of the frame, ochre wall of dust against a low warm sun. The sun is just above the horizon, casting a long shadow behind Luke. Power-pole silhouettes recede into the distance.

[Format] Cinematic anamorphic 16:9 landscape, 2.39:1 widescreen feel rendered to fit 16:9.

[Style] Hyperreal cinematic photography, anamorphic lens flare hint across the upper third, slight film grain, desaturated warm-rust colour grade (Mad Max Fury Road by way of Sweetgrass), atmospheric dust haze diffusing the light. Editorial composition — Luke roughly on the right thirds, machine on the left thirds, dust storm filling the upper right. Premium production-still quality.

CAP LOCK — character invariant: Luke ALWAYS wears his black baseball cap with the brim facing forward. Cap firmly on his head, dust-stained, brim casting a small shadow over his sunglasses. Do NOT render him bareheaded. Do NOT replace the cap with any other hat, headwrap, bandana, or post-apocalyptic helmet. The cap stays, fitted and dusty.
